load_llama4_tokenizer: load a LLaMA 4 tokenizer from a tiktoken model file path with a Llama4TokenizerConfig
create_Llama4TokenizerConfig: create a Llama4TokenizerConfig dataclass with use_eot and split_regex settings for tokenizer behavior
get_reserved_special_tokens: generate a list of reserved special token strings with a given name, count, and start index
review_LLAMA4_SPECIAL_TOKENS: review the combined LLaMA 4 special tokens list including text, vision, and reasoning tokens
summarize_BASIC_SPECIAL_TOKENS: summarize the basic special tokens list including begin_of_text, end_of_text, and fence tokens
